sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 495 (four loops, 73 campsites; lengths parsed for 69)

values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/little-pond-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=495 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 nights. From July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights will be permitted at any campground'; CHECK-IN TIME 'From 2:00 p.m. until 9:00 p.m.') + https://dec.ny.gov/sites/default/files/2025-04/summerreccampgroundsummary.pdf (Little Pond RES MIN 2; reservation-minimum footnote), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DEC lists 75 sites; ReserveAmerica sells 73. Of sites 1-67, 3 are listed at 40 ft, 50 at 30 ft and 8 at 20 ft; sites 68-75 are the walk-in/boat-in remote sites ('Hike In' sites cannot be driven to).

You cannot drive to the site'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $22 + $5 non-resident, 2-night pre-season reservation minimum and phone (DEC 2026 summary), ReserveAmerica booking, 2027 season May 14 - Oct 10 (DEC 2026 closes Oct 12), 75 sites to 40 ft (now manual). NEW: 9-month window and 14-night max (were inherited), no electric, water spigots; sites 68-75 are walk-in/boat-in.
